{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the trial data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the unique sites
print("Unique sites:", df['site'].unique())

# Compute response rate by site
site_response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100  # Convert to percent
print("Response rates by site (percent):", site_response_rates)

# Find the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = site_response_rates.idxmax()
highest_rate = site_response_rates.max()

print(f"Highest response rate: {highest_rate:.2f}% at {highest_site}")"}
